To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) a belief network can regularize activities of a neural network during learning, and that this can be used to achieve state-of-the-art performance on image classification tasks; 2) the learnt belief network parameters are close to the neural network parameters; 3) the dropout network regularizes according to the magnitude of the neural network activities, which is a desirable property for a regularization method.

(1) adaptive dropout networks can be trained using a stochastic gradient descent algorithm, and (2) they achieve lower classification error rates on the MNIST, NORB, CIFAR-10, and STL datasets than other feature learning approaches, including denoising autoencoders, restricted Boltzmann machine, convolutional neural networks, and standard dropout.

(1) adaptive dropout networks are an efficient and effective feature learning method that can be used to train deep neural networks, and (2) the learnt dropout network regularizes hidden units according to their magnitudes.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question of how to regularize hidden activities in a neural network.
developing methods that can be used to train deep architectures, including convolutional neural networks, in a supervised or unsupervised manner.
developing new regularization methods for neural network training.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the method presented in this paper is a good feature learning method that can be used to learn features from unlabeled data, but it is not a good classification method, and that the method can be improved by using a convolutional architecture.
adaptive dropout is a powerful and flexible method for training neural networks, and that it is a useful addition to the toolbox of deep learning algorithms.
adaptive dropout is an effective and practical method for training deep neural network models.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the adaptive dropout network is a simple and efficient method for training deep neural nets.
we have developed a novel feature learning method that can be used to train deep neural networks and achieve good classification accuracy.
we have developed a novel method for training deep neural network models using adaptive dropout, which achieves lower error rates than previous state-of-the-art feature learning methods.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a simple belief network can be used to regularize a neural network during training, and that this regularization can be used to improve the classification accuracy on a number of benchmark datasets.
a simple belief network that is trained jointly with the deep neural network is able to learn good features that can be used to regularize the neural network during learning.
the belief network can be viewed as a regularizer that can be trained to improve the performance of neural networks.
